heading: Nature kept the core.

description: Across vertebrate species, oxygen transport shares a common molecular foundation in hemoglobin.

Heme b molecular structure with iron at the centre

slides.title: Related chemistry. Different roles.
paragraphs: Heme and chlorophyll belong to the tetrapyrrole family. Their metals, ring structures and side chains differ.
Hemoglobin transports oxygen. Chlorophyll absorbs light in photosynthesis.
